risk_if_not_implemented: Without Reserve Hardware, data, software and system images cannot be reliably restored within required recovery objectives following a disruption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Business / Service Interruption (R-BC-1), Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), Concentration / Single-Point Dependency Failure (R-OR-2), Third-Party Dependency Failure (R-SC-6), Loss of Data / Service Availability (R-IP-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to man-made threats MT-5, MT-9, MT-19, MT-20, MT-22, MT-23, MT-24, MT-26.

compensating_control_1.name: Alternate Processing Site
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate processing site that provides processing capability and security measures equivalent to that of the primary site.
compensating_control_1.justification: Alternate Processing Site (BCD-13) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Reserve Hardware (BCD-20) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Elastic Expansion
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to automatically scale the resources available for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), as demand conditions change.
compensating_control_2.justification: Elastic Expansion (CAP-06) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Reserve Hardware (BCD-20) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
